map.法律文书印花税计算器 使用指南: Legal Document Stamp Duty Calculator User Guide
map.选择合同或法律文书类型并输入金额，按《印花税法》对应税目与税率计算应纳印花税，覆: Choose the contract or legal document type and enter the amount; the corresponding tax item and rate from the Stamp Duty Law are applied to compute the payable stamp duty, covering sale and purchase, loan, and property transfer documents for a pre-filing self-check.
map.签订应税合同（借款、买卖、租赁等）前，按计税金额与税率估算印花税。: Before signing a taxable contract (loan, sale and purchase, lease, and so on), estimate the stamp duty from the taxable amount and the rate.
map.金额未列明的应税凭证暂按 5 元贴花。: A taxable instrument with no stated amount pays a provisional 5 CNY stamp.
map.小规模纳税人可享受减半征收。: Small-scale taxpayers can enjoy half-rate collection.
map.：借款金额 100 万元，借款合同印花税税率 0.005%：100万 × 0.0: : Loan amount 1 million CNY with a loan contract stamp duty rate of 0.005%: 1,000,000 × 0.005% = 50 CNY; small-scale taxpayers pay half, 25 CNY.
map.：购销金额 100 万元，税率 0.03%：100万 × 0.03% = 300: : Sale and purchase amount 1 million CNY at a 0.03% rate: 1,000,000 × 0.03% = 300 CNY (150 CNY for small-scale taxpayers at half rate).
map.印花税应税凭证含借款合同、买卖合同、租赁合同、承揽合同、产权转移书据等；部分非应: Taxable instruments include loan contracts, sale and purchase contracts, lease contracts, work contracts, and property transfer documents; some non-taxable items (such as personal insurance contracts and interbank lending) are not levied.
map.金额没写清怎么算？: How Is It Calculated When the Amount Is Not Stated?
map.应税但金额未列明的，暂按 5 元贴花，结算后补贴；小规模纳税人等可享减征优惠。: If a taxable instrument does not state the amount, a 5 CNY stamp is paid provisionally and reconciled afterwards; small-scale taxpayers and similar filers can enjoy reduced collection.
